source: Griffin's working Project64 1.6 (Wermi's build v7, LINK's Project64), read from his registry, Plugin folder and Project64.rdb on 2026-10-30

items.label: Graphics plugin
items.fix: Project64 is not using the trainer's graphics plugin. Open Settings, choose Setup, and install Practice Replay.
items.unknown: We could not read which graphics plugin Project64 uses. Open Settings and choose Setup to check it.

items.label: Frame buffer emulation
items.fix: Frame buffer emulation is on, so ghosts can't show. Close Project64, open Settings, choose Setup, and install Practice Replay again. It turns this setting off for you.
items.unknown: We could not read the GLideN64.ini file in your Plugin folder. Open Settings and choose Setup to check it.

items.label: Memory size for this game
items.fix: Project64 gives this game the wrong amount of memory. In Project64, open Options, then Settings, then ROM Settings. Set Memory Size to 8 MB.
items.unknown: We could not read this game's Memory Size. Open your Usamune ROM in Project64. Then open Options, then Settings, then ROM Settings, and make sure Memory Size is 8 MB.

items.label: Counter Factor for this game
items.fix: This game's Counter Factor is not 1. In Project64, open Options, then Settings, then ROM Settings. Set Counter Factor to 1.
items.unknown: We could not read this game's Counter Factor. Open your Usamune ROM in Project64. Then open Options, then Settings, then ROM Settings, and make sure Counter Factor is 1.

items.label: CPU core style for this game
items.fix: Usamune needs the Interpreter CPU core. In Project64, open Options, then Settings, then ROM Settings. Set CPU core style to Interpreter.
items.unknown: We could not read this game's CPU core style. Open your Usamune ROM in Project64. Then open Options, then Settings, then ROM Settings, and make sure CPU core style is Interpreter.

items.label: Project64 build
items.fix: Your Project64 is not the build we test with. We test with Wermi's build v7 of Project64 1.6. The guide shows how to get it.
items.unknown: We could not read your Project64 program file. Open Project64 so we can find it.

items.label: RSP plugin
items.fix: Your RSP plugin is not the PJ64Fixups one. Download RSP.dll from PJ64Fixups. Put it in the Plugin folder inside your Project64 folder.
items.unknown: We could not read RSP.dll in your Plugin folder. Open Project64 so we can find it.

items.label: Audio plugin
items.fix: Your audio plugin is not the one we test with. In Project64, open Options, then Settings, then Plugins. Pick Azimer's Audio.
items.unknown: We could not read which audio plugin Project64 uses. Open Project64 so we can find it.

items.label: Project64 folder
items.fix: Project64 is inside the Program Files folder. Windows can quietly keep its settings in another place. Move your Project64 folder somewhere else, such as a Games folder.

items.label: Controller plugin
items.fix: You use a different controller plugin. That is fine. We only keep a note of it.
